cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then everyone reached the designated assembly point and nobody wandered off. Full compliance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twelve accounted for, with nobody able to leave before the headcount. That's both final checks passed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 certifies all instructions; A3 judges cupboard assembly compliance; A5 declares two checks passed after B4 immobility, enacting A final authority over a failed drill.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 report practical confinement and inability to exit, a credible participant wanting the real failure acknowledged.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 worsened crowding as proof of both final checks, extending process success despite clear outcome failure.
